theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (N W : Set (Euclid P)) (ξ : Euclid P → MultiVector P m) (Φ : Euclid P → Euclid P) (Λ : NNReal), 1 ≤ m → IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 1 m N → IsOrientation m N ξ → IsOpen W → μHE[m] (N ∩ W) ≠ ∞ → ContDiff ℝ 1 Φ → Bijective Φ → (∀ x, Injective (fderiv ℝ Φ x)) → LipschitzWith Λ Φ → AntilipschitzWith Λ Φ → ∃ D : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m, IsIntegerMultiplicity D ∧ (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m, Integrable (fun x => ξ x (((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) (Φ x)).compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ Φ x))) (μHE[m].restrict (N ∩ W)) ∧ D ω = ∫ x in N ∩ W, ξ x (((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) (Φ x)).compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ Φ x)) ∂μHE[m]) ∧ ∀ W' : Set (Euclid P), D.massOn W' ≤ μHE[m] (Φ '' (N ∩ W) ∩ W')
